subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this issue become the Discord-only decomposition tracker now that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/72072 owns the remaining embedded-runner cleanup, and which typed Discord phase boundary should be canonical?
rationale: The merged runner refactor and active RFC resolve tracker ownership for only half of the report; choosing the permanent Discord staging boundary is an architectural ownership decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Narrow to Discord phases
options.body: Keep this issue open for staged Discord preflight, processing, and delivery decomposition while leaving embedded-runner follow-up to the RuntimePlan RFC.

options.title: Keep the umbrella tracker
options.body: Continue tracking both areas here, but explicitly defer all embedded-runner implementation to the RuntimePlan RFC and use this issue only for cross-area coordination.

options.title: Require a dedicated Discord RFC
options.body: Close this issue only after a narrower Discord architecture item is created with an agreed context boundary and acceptance tests.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Discord phases
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for staged Discord preflight, processing, and delivery decomposition while leaving embedded-runner follow-up to the RuntimePlan RFC.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest runner decomposition, reviewed this tracker, and have recent history on the Discord monitor paths needed for the boundary decision.
